about: unseen_ranges is every range of code points of the general categories Cc, Cf, Zl, Zp and Co in Unicode 17, first and last: uploads.rs is_unseen is held to it for every character in a test of that file, and the engine is held to it in extension/tests/upload-trusted.test.mjs. files holds file names with the result both halves of choose_file give each: crates/browser/src/uploads.rs choose() in a test of that file, and extension/files.js problemWithFile() in extension/tests/upload-trusted.test.mjs. above is the directories above the uploads directory, file the path below it. chosen: the file is given; refused: the one sentence of a path that is not a regular file inside uploads; credential: the sentence of a credential name.
